hero.heading: Facials & Dermaplaning
hero.body: Results-driven facials that still feel like a treat. Every facial is customized to your skin after a quick consultation, whether you're navigating breakouts, chasing a glow, or simply need to exhale.

image.alt: Hydrating mask being applied during a customized facial at Rosemary Esthetics in Idaho Falls

items: Arrive with clean skin if you can, and skip retinol and strong exfoliants for a few days before your visit.
Avoid fresh sunburn. We can't treat sunburned or irritated skin, so plan around heavy sun days.
Dermaplaning bonus: makeup goes on smoother and skincare absorbs better afterward.
Couples Facial: bring a friend, partner, or mom. Two side-by-side facials in one relaxing hour.

steps.title: Consultation
steps.body: We talk through your skin, your goals, and anything you'd like to focus on. Every facial is built around you.

steps.title: Cleanse and exfoliate
steps.body: A double cleanse followed by exfoliation matched to your skin. The Smooth + Glow Facial (Dermaplane) adds gentle dermaplaning to remove peach fuzz and dead skin.

steps.title: Treat and mask
steps.body: Targeted serums, a customized mask, and plenty of relaxing touches. Add gua sha sculpting or calming LED light for a little extra.

steps.title: Protect and plan
steps.body: Moisturizer and SPF to finish, plus simple homecare tips. Most clients love a facial every 4–6 weeks.
